::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 46,751 people lived in County Longford, up 14.4% on 2016. It had the second smallest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 40% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Longford was €1,120, the 19th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
